summary.cn: 鲁迅的经典小说（1921年）。“我”回到二十多年没有回去的故乡，准备卖掉老屋、带母亲搬家。童年的好朋友闰土也来了，可是两个人之间已经有了一层看不见的厚墙。
summary.en: Lu Xun's classic short story (1921). The narrator returns to the hometown he left over twenty years ago to sell the family house and move his mother away. His childhood friend Runtu comes to see him, but an invisible wall now stands between them.

sentences.cn: 我冒了严寒，回到相隔二千余里，别了二十余年的故乡去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mào le yánhán, huídào xiānggé èrqiān yúlǐ, bié le èrshí yú nián de gùxiāng qù.
sentences.en: Braving the bitter cold, I went back to my hometown, more than two thousand li away, which I had left over twenty years before.

sentences.cn: 时候既然是深冬；渐近故乡时，天气又阴晦了，冷风吹进船舱中，呜呜的响，从蓬隙向外一望，苍黄的天底下，远近横着几个萧索的荒村，没有一些活气。
sentences.pinyin: Shíhou jìrán shì shēn dōng; jiànjìn gùxiāng shí, tiānqì yòu yīnhuì le, lěng fēng chuījìn chuáncāng zhōng, wūwū de xiǎng, cóng péngxì xiàng wài yíwàng, cānghuáng de tiān dǐxià, yuǎnjìn héngzhe jǐgè xiāosuǒ de huāngcūn, méiyǒu yìxiē huóqì.
sentences.en: It was the depth of winter; as we drew near my hometown the sky turned gloomy, and a cold wind howled into the cabin of the boat. Looking out through a gap in the awning, I saw a few bleak, desolate villages scattered near and far under a grey-yellow sky, without the least sign of life.

sentences.cn: 我的心禁不住悲凉起来了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de xīn jīnbúzhù bēiliáng qǐlái le.
sentences.en: I could not help feeling a deep sadness.

sentences.cn: 阿！这不是我二十年来时时记得的故乡？
sentences.pinyin: Ā! Zhè búshì wǒ èrshí niánlái shíshí jìde de gùxiāng?
sentences.en: Ah! Was this really the hometown I had remembered all through those twenty years?

sentences.cn: 我所记得的故乡全不如此。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ suǒ jìde de gùxiāng quán bù rúcǐ.
sentences.en: The hometown I remembered was nothing like this.

sentences.cn: 我的故乡好得多了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de gùxiāng hǎo de duō le.
sentences.en: My hometown was far better.

sentences.cn: 但要我记起他的美丽，说出他的佳处来，却又没有影像，没有言辞了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn yào wǒ jìqǐ tā de měilì, shuōchū tā de jiāchù lái, què yòu méiyǒu yǐngxiàng, méiyǒu yáncí le.
sentences.en: But if I tried to recall its beauty and put its good points into words, I found no image and no words.

sentences.cn: 仿佛也就如此。
sentences.pinyin: Fǎngfú yějiù rúcǐ.
sentences.en: It seemed it had been just like this after all.

sentences.cn: 于是我自己解释说：故乡本也如此，——虽然没有进步，也未必有如我所感的悲凉，这只是我自己心情的改变罢了，因为我这次回乡，本没有什么好心绪。
sentences.pinyin: Yúshì wǒ zìjǐ jiěshì shuō: gùxiāng běn yě rúcǐ, ——suīrán méiyǒu jìnbù, yě wèibì yǒurú wǒ suǒgǎn de bēiliáng, zhè zhǐshì wǒ zìjǐ xīnqíng de gǎibiàn bàle, yīnwèi wǒ zhècì huí xiāng, běn méiyǒu shénme hǎo xīnxù.
sentences.en: So I explained it to myself: my hometown had always been like this — though it had not improved, it was perhaps not as sad as I felt; it was only my own mood that had changed, because I had come home this time in no good spirits.

sentences.cn: 我这次是专为了别他而来的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhècì shì zhuān wèile bié tā érlái de.
sentences.en: I had come this time only to bid it farewell.

sentences.cn: 我们多年聚族而居的老屋，已经公同卖给别姓了，交屋的期限，只在本年，所以必须赶在正月初一以前，永别了熟识的老屋，而且远离了熟识的故乡，搬家到我在谋食的异地去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen duōnián jùzú'érjū de lǎowū, yǐjīng gōngtóng mài gěi bié xìng le, jiāo wū de qīxiàn, zhǐ zài běn nián, suǒyǐ bìxū gǎn zài zhēngyuèchūyī yǐqián, yǒngbié le shúshi de lǎowū, érqiě yuǎnlí le shúshi de gùxiāng, bānjiā dào wǒ zài móushí de yìdì qù.
sentences.en: The old house where our clan had lived together for so many years had been sold jointly to another family, and it had to be handed over before the year was out. So before New Year's Day we had to say goodbye forever to the familiar old house, leave our familiar hometown far behind, and move to the distant place where I was earning my living.

sentences.cn: 第二日清早晨我到了我家的门口了。
sentences.pinyin: Dì'èrrì qīngzǎochén wǒ dào le wǒ jiā de ménkǒu le.
sentences.en: Early the next morning I reached the gate of our house.

sentences.cn: 瓦楞上许多枯草的断茎当风抖着，正在说明这老屋难免易主的原因。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎléng shàng xǔduō kūcǎo de duànjīng dāng fēng dǒu zhe, zhèngzài shuōmíng zhè lǎowū nánmiǎn yìzhǔ de yuányīn.
sentences.en: Broken stems of withered grass trembled in the wind along the ridges of the roof tiles, as if explaining why the old house could not avoid changing hands.

sentences.cn: 几房的本家大约已经搬走了，所以很寂静。
sentences.pinyin: Jǐ fáng de běnjiā dàyuē yǐjīng bānzǒu le, suǒyǐ hěn jìjìng.
sentences.en: Most of the other branches of the family had probably already moved out, so it was very quiet.

sentences.cn: 我到了自家的房外，我的母亲早已迎着出来了，接着便飞出了八岁的侄儿宏儿。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dào le zì jiā de fáng wài, wǒ de mǔqīn zǎoyǐ yíng zhe chūlái le, jiēzhe biàn fēi chū le bāsuì de zhí'ér Hóng'ér.
sentences.en: When I reached our own rooms, my mother had already come out to meet me, and then my eight-year-old nephew Hong'er came flying out too.

sentences.cn: 我的母亲很高兴，但也藏着许多凄凉的神情，教我坐下，歇息，喝茶，且不谈搬家的事。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de mǔqīn hěn gāoxìng, dàn yě cángzhe xǔduō qīliáng de shénqíng, jiào wǒ zuòxià, xiēxi, hēchá, qiě bù tán bānjiā de shì.
sentences.en: My mother was very happy, though she was also hiding a good deal of sadness. She had me sit down, rest and drink some tea, and for the moment said nothing about the move.

sentences.cn: 宏儿没有见过我，远远的对面站着只是看。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng'ér méiyǒu jiànguò wǒ, yuǎnyuǎn de duìmiàn zhàn zhe zhǐshì kàn.
sentences.en: Hong'er had never seen me before; he stood some way off, facing me, and just stared.

sentences.cn: 但我们终于谈到搬家的事。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn wǒmen zhōngyú tándào bānjiā de shì.
sentences.en: But in the end we did talk about the move.

sentences.cn: 我说外间的寓所已经租定了，又买了几件家具，此外须将家里所有的木器卖去，再去增添。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shuō wài jiān de yùsuǒ yǐjīng zūdìng le, yòu mǎi le jǐ jiàn jiājù, cǐwài xū jiāng jiālǐ suǒyǒu de mùqì mài qù, zàiqù zēngtiān.
sentences.en: I said I had already rented a place to live out there and bought a few pieces of furniture; beyond that, we would have to sell all the wooden furniture here and buy more later.

sentences.cn: 母亲也说好，而且行李也略已齐集，木器不便搬运的，也小半卖去了，只是收不起钱来。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn yě shuō hǎo, érqiě xíngli yě lüè yǐ qíjí, mùqì búbiàn bānyùn de, yě xiǎobàn mài qù le, zhǐshì shōu buqǐ qián lái.
sentences.en: Mother agreed, and said the luggage was mostly packed already; some of the furniture that was hard to move had been sold, only the money was hard to collect.

sentences.cn: “你休息一两天，去拜望亲戚本家一回，我们便可以走了。”母亲说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǐ xiūxi yì liǎng tiān, qù bàiwàng qīnqi běnjiā yìhuí, wǒmen biàn kěyǐ zǒu le.” Mǔqīn shuō.
sentences.en: "Rest for a day or two, pay a visit to our relatives, and then we can go," Mother said.

sentences.cn: “是的。”
sentences.pinyin: “Shì de.”
sentences.en: "Yes."

sentences.cn: “还有闰土，他每到我家来时，总问起你，很想见你一回面。
sentences.pinyin: “Háiyǒu Rùntǔ, tā měi dào wǒ jiā lái shí, zǒng wèn qǐ nǐ, hěnxiǎng jiàn nǐ yìhuí miàn.
sentences.en: "And there's Runtu. Every time he comes to our house he asks about you; he very much wants to see you once.

sentences.cn: 我已经将你到家的大约日期通知他，他也许就要来了。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng jiāng nǐ dàojiā de dàyuē rìqī tōngzhī tā, tā yěxǔ jiùyào lái le.”
sentences.en: I've let him know roughly when you'd be home, so he may come any time now."

sentences.cn: 这时候，我的脑里忽然闪出一幅神异的图画来：深蓝的天空中挂着一轮金黄的圆月，下面是海边的沙地，都种着一望无际的碧绿的西瓜，其间有一个十一二岁的少年，项带银圈，手捏一柄钢叉，向一匹猹尽力的刺去，那猹却将身一扭，反从他的胯下逃走了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, wǒ de nǎo lǐ hūrán shǎnchū yìfú shényì de túhuà lái: shēnlán de tiānkōng zhōng guà zhe yìlún jīnhuáng de yuányuè, xiàmiàn shì hǎibiān de shādì, dōu zhòng zhe yíwàngwújì de bìlǜ de xīguā, qíjiān yǒu yígè shíyī èr suì de shàonián, xiàng dài yínquān, shǒu niē yì bǐng gāngchā, xiàng yìpǐ chá jìnlì de cì qù, nà chá què jiāng shēn yì niǔ, fǎn cóng tā de kuàxià táozǒu le.
sentences.en: At that moment a wonderful picture suddenly flashed into my mind: a round golden moon hanging in a deep blue sky, and below it sandy land by the sea, planted with jade-green watermelons stretching as far as the eye could see. Among them stood a boy of eleven or twelve, a silver ring around his neck and a steel pitchfork in his hand, stabbing with all his strength at a zha. But the zha twisted its body and escaped between his legs.

sentences.cn: 这少年便是闰土。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shàonián biànshì Rùntǔ.
sentences.en: That boy was Runtu.

sentences.cn: 我认识他时，也不过十多岁，离现在将有三十年了；那时我的父亲还在世，家景也好，我正是一个少爷。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ rènshi tā shí, yě búguò shíduōsuì, lí xiànzài jiāng yǒu sānshí nián le; nàshí wǒ de fùqīn hái zàishì, jiājǐng yěhǎo, wǒ zhèngshì yígè shàoye.
sentences.en: When I met him I was only a little over ten myself — nearly thirty years ago now. My father was still alive then, the family was well off, and I was a young master.

sentences.cn: 那一年，我家是一件大祭祀的值年。
sentences.pinyin: Nà yì nián, wǒ jiā shì yíjiàn dà jìsì de zhínián.
sentences.en: That year it was our family's turn to host a great ancestral ceremony.

sentences.cn: 这祭祀，说是三十多年才能轮到一回，所以很郑重；正月里供祖像，供品很多，祭器很讲究，拜的人也很多，祭器也很要防偷去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jìsì, shuō shì sānshí duō nián cáinéng lúndào yìhuí, suǒyǐ hěn zhèngzhòng; zhēngyuè lǐ gòng zǔxiàng, gòngpǐn hěnduō, jìqì hěn jiǎngjiū, bài de rén yě hěnduō, jìqì yě hěn yào fáng tōuqù.
sentences.en: It was said this turn came round only once in thirty-odd years, so it was taken very seriously. In the first month the ancestors' portraits were set out, with many offerings and fine ritual vessels; many people came to worship, and the vessels had to be guarded against theft.

sentences.cn: 我家只有一个忙月（我们这里给人做工的分三种：整年给一定人家做工的叫长工；按日给人做工的叫短工；自己也种地，只在过年过节以及收租时候来给一定人家做工的称忙月），忙不过来，他便对父亲说，可以叫他的儿子闰土来管祭器的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhǐyǒu yígè mángyuè (wǒmen zhèlǐ gěirén zuògōng de fēn sān zhǒng: zhěng nián gěi yídìng rénjiā zuògōng de jiào chánggōng; àn rì gěirén zuògōng de jiào duǎngōng; zìjǐ yě zhòngdì, zhǐ zài guònián guòjié yǐjí shōuzū shíhou láigěi yídìng rénjiā zuògōng de chēng mángyuè), máng búguò lái, tā biàn duì fùqīn shuō, kěyǐ jiào tā de érzi Rùntǔ lái guǎn jìqì de.
sentences.en: We had only one "busy-month" man (here, hired workers came in three kinds: those who worked all year for one family were long-term hands; those hired by the day were day labourers; and those who farmed their own land but came to work for a particular family only at New Year, at festivals and when rents were collected were called busy-month men). He couldn't manage it all alone, so he told my father he could send for his son Runtu to look after the ritual vessels.

sentences.cn: 我的父亲允许了；我也很高兴，因为我早听到闰土这名字，而且知道他和我仿佛年纪，闰月生的，五行缺土，所以他的父亲叫他闰土。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de fùqīn yǔnxǔ le; wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng, yīnwèi wǒ zǎo tīngdào Rùntǔ zhè míngzi, érqiě zhīdào tā hé wǒ fǎngfú niánjì, rùnyuè shēng de, wǔxíng quē tǔ, suǒyǐ tā de fùqīn jiào tā Rùntǔ.
sentences.en: My father agreed, and I was delighted too, for I had long heard the name Runtu and knew he was about my age. He had been born in a leap month, and his horoscope lacked the element earth, so his father named him Runtu — "leap earth."

sentences.cn: 他是能装弶捉小鸟雀的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì néng zhuāng jiàng zhuō xiǎo niǎoquè de.
sentences.en: And he knew how to set traps to catch little birds.

sentences.cn: 我于是日日盼望新年，新年到，闰土也就到了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yúshì rì rì pànwàng xīnnián, xīnnián dào, Rùntǔ yějiù dào le.
sentences.en: So day after day I longed for the New Year, for when the New Year came, Runtu would come too.

sentences.cn: 好容易到了年末，有一日，母亲告诉我，闰土来了，我便飞跑的去看。
sentences.pinyin: Hǎoróngyì dào le niánmò, yǒu yírì, mǔqīn gàosu wǒ, Rùntǔ lái le, wǒ biàn fēi pǎo de qù kàn.
sentences.en: At long last the end of the year arrived. One day Mother told me Runtu had come, and I ran like the wind to see him.

sentences.cn: 他正在厨房里，紫色的圆脸，头戴一顶小毡帽，颈上套一个明晃晃的银项圈，这可见他的父亲十分爱他，怕他死去，所以在神佛面前许下愿心，用圈子将他套住了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài chúfáng lǐ, zǐsè de yuán liǎn, tóu dài yìdǐng xiǎo zhānmào, jǐng shàng tào yígè mínghuǎnghuǎng de yínxiàngquān, zhè kějiàn tā de fùqīn shífēn ài tā, pà tā sǐqù, suǒyǐ zài shén fó miànqián xǔxià yuànxīn, yòng quānzi jiāng tā tàozhù le.
sentences.en: He was in the kitchen: a round, ruddy-purple face, a little felt cap on his head, and a gleaming silver ring around his neck. This showed how much his father loved him — afraid he might die, he had made a vow before the gods and Buddha and fastened him to life with the ring.

sentences.cn: 他见人很怕羞，只是不怕我，没有旁人的时候，便和我说话，于是不到半日，我们便熟识了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā jiàn rén hěn pàxiū, zhǐshì búpà wǒ, méiyǒu pángrén de shíhou, biàn hé wǒ shuōhuà, yúshì búdào bànrì, wǒmen biàn shúshi le.
sentences.en: He was very shy with people, but not with me. When nobody else was around he would talk to me, and in less than half a day we were friends.

sentences.cn: 我们那时候不知道谈些什么，只记得闰土很高兴，说是上城之后，见了许多没有见过的东西。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen nà shíhou bùzhīdào tán xiē shénme, zhǐ jìde Rùntǔ hěn gāoxìng, shuō shì shàngchéng zhīhòu, jiàn le xǔduō méiyǒu jiànguò de dōngxi.
sentences.en: I don't know what we talked about then; I only remember that Runtu was very happy, and said that since coming to town he had seen lots of things he'd never seen before.

sentences.cn: 第二日，我便要他捕鸟。他说：
sentences.pinyin: Dì'èrrì, wǒ biàn yào tā bǔ niǎo. Tā shuō:
sentences.en: The next day I wanted him to catch birds. He said:

sentences.cn: “这不能。须大雪下了才好。
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè bùnéng. Xū dàxuě xià le cáihǎo.
sentences.en: "Can't do it now. We need a heavy snowfall first.

sentences.cn: 我们沙地上，下了雪，我扫出一块空地来，用短棒支起一个大竹匾，撒下秕谷，看鸟雀来吃时，我远远地将缚在棒上的绳子只一拉，那鸟雀就罩在竹匾下了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen shādì shàng, xià le xuě, wǒ sǎo chū yíkuài kòngdì lái, yòng duǎn bàng zhī qǐ yígè dà zhúbiǎn, sāxià bǐgǔ, kàn niǎoquè lái chī shí, wǒ yuǎnyuǎn de jiāng fù zài bàng shàng de shéngzi zhǐ yì lā, nà niǎoquè jiù zhàozài zhúbiǎn xià le.
sentences.en: On our sandy land, when it snows, I sweep a patch clear, prop up a big bamboo tray with a short stick and scatter some husks. When the birds come to eat, I give one tug from far away on the string tied to the stick, and the birds are trapped under the tray.

sentences.cn: 什么都有：稻鸡，角鸡，鹁鸪，蓝背……”
sentences.pinyin: Shénme dōu yǒu: dàojī, jiǎojī, bógū, lánbèi……”
sentences.en: You get all kinds: rice birds, horned pheasants, wood pigeons, blue-backs…"

sentences.cn: 我于是又很盼望下雪。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yúshì yòu hěn pànwàng xiàxuě.
sentences.en: After that, I longed for snow as well.

sentences.cn: 闰土又对我说：
sentences.pinyin: Rùntǔ yòu duì wǒ shuō:
sentences.en: Runtu also told me:

sentences.cn: “现在太冷，你夏天到我们这里来。
sentences.pinyin: “Xiànzài tài lěng, nǐ xiàtiān dào wǒmen zhèlǐ lái.
sentences.en: "It's too cold now. Come to our place in the summer.

sentences.cn: 我们日里到海边捡贝壳去，红的绿的都有，鬼见怕也有，观音手也有。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen rìlǐ dào hǎibiān jiǎn bèiké qù, hóngde lǜ de dōu yǒu, guǐjiànpà yě yǒu, Guānyīnshǒu yě yǒu.
sentences.en: In the daytime we'll go to the seashore to pick up shells — there are red ones and green ones, 'ghost-scarers' and 'Guanyin's hands' too.

sentences.cn: 晚上我和爹管西瓜去，你也去。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshàng wǒ hé diē guǎn xīguā qù, nǐ yěqù.”
sentences.en: In the evening Dad and I go to guard the watermelons. You can come too."

sentences.cn: “管贼么？”
sentences.pinyin: “Guǎn zéi me?”
sentences.en: "Guard them from thieves?"

sentences.cn: “不是。走路的人口渴了摘一个瓜吃，我们这里是不算偷的。
sentences.pinyin: “Búshì. Zǒulù de rén kǒukě le zhāi yígè guā chī, wǒmen zhèlǐ shì búsuàn tōu de.
sentences.en: "No. If someone walking by gets thirsty and picks a melon to eat, around here we don't call that stealing.

sentences.cn: 要管的是獾猪，刺猬，猹。
sentences.pinyin: Yào guǎn de shì huānzhū, cìwei, chá.
sentences.en: What we guard against are badgers, hedgehogs and zha.

sentences.cn: 月亮底下，你听，啦啦的响了，猹在咬瓜了。
sentences.pinyin: Yuèliàng dǐxià, nǐ tīng, lā lā de xiǎng le, chá zài yǎo guā le.
sentences.en: Under the moon, you listen — there's a crunching sound: a zha is biting a melon.

sentences.cn: 你便捏了胡叉，轻轻地走去……”
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ biàn niē le húchā, qīngqīng de zǒuqù……”
sentences.en: Then you grab your pitchfork and creep over quietly…"

sentences.cn: 我那时并不知道这所谓猹的是怎么一件东西——便是现在也没有知道——只是无端的觉得状如小狗而很凶猛。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ nàshí bìng bùzhīdào zhè suǒwèi chá de shì zěnme yíjiàn dōngxi——biànshì xiànzài yě méiyǒu zhīdào——zhǐshì wúduān de juéde zhuàng rú xiǎogǒu ér hěn xiōngměng.
sentences.en: At the time I had no idea what this so-called zha was — and I still don't know now — I just imagined, for no reason, that it looked like a little dog and was very fierce.

sentences.cn: “他不咬人么？”
sentences.pinyin: “Tā bù yǎorén me?”
sentences.en: "Doesn't it bite people?"

sentences.cn: “有胡叉呢。走到了，看见猹了，你便刺。
sentences.pinyin: “Yǒu húchā ne. Zǒudào le, kànjiàn chá le, nǐ biàn cì.
sentences.en: "You've got the pitchfork. You get there, you see the zha, you stab.

sentences.cn: 这畜生很伶俐，倒向你奔来，反从胯下窜了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè chùsheng hěn línglì, dàoxiàng nǐ bēn lái, fǎn cóng kuàxià cuàn le.
sentences.en: But the creature is very clever — it rushes straight at you and darts away between your legs.

sentences.cn: 他的皮毛是油一般的滑……”
sentences.pinyin: Tā de pímáo shì yóu yìbān de huá……”
sentences.en: Its fur is as slippery as oil…"

sentences.cn: 我素不知道天下有这许多新鲜事：海边有如许五色的贝壳；西瓜有这样危险的经历，我先前单知道他在水果店里出卖罢了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ sù bùzhīdào tiānxià yǒu zhè xǔduō xīnxiān shì: hǎibiān yǒu rúxǔ wǔsè de bèiké; xīguā yǒu zhèyàng wēixiǎn de jīnglì, wǒ xiānqián dān zhīdào tā zài shuǐguǒdiàn lǐ chūmài bàle.
sentences.en: I had never known there were so many new and wonderful things in the world: that the seashore had shells of so many colours, and that watermelons had such dangerous adventures — before, I had only known that they were sold in fruit shops.

sentences.cn: “我们沙地里，潮汛要来的时候，就有许多跳鱼儿只是跳，都有青蛙似的两个脚……”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒmen shādì lǐ, cháoxùn yào lái de shíhou, jiùyǒu xǔduō tiàoyúr zhǐshì tiào, dōu yǒu qīngwā shìde liǎng gè jiǎo……”
sentences.en: "On our sandy land, when the high tide is coming, lots of jumping fish just keep jumping about. They all have two legs, like frogs…"

sentences.cn: 阿！闰土的心里有无穷无尽的希奇的事，都是我往常的朋友所不知道的。
sentences.pinyin: Ā! Rùntǔ de xīnlǐ yǒu wúqióngwújìn de xīqí de shì, dōushì wǒ wǎngcháng de péngyou suǒ bùzhīdào de.
sentences.en: Ah! Runtu's mind was full of endless marvels that none of my usual friends knew anything about.

sentences.cn: 他们不知道一些事，闰土在海边时，他们都和我一样只看见院子里高墙上的四角的天空。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen bùzhīdào yìxiē shì, Rùntǔ zài hǎibiān shí, tāmen dōu hé wǒ yíyàng zhǐ kànjiàn yuànzi lǐ gāo qiáng shàng de sìjiǎo de tiānkōng.
sentences.en: They knew nothing of such things. While Runtu was by the sea, they, like me, could only see the square of sky above the high walls of the courtyard.

sentences.cn: 可惜正月过去了，闰土须回家里去，我急得大哭，他也躲到厨房里，哭着不肯出门，但终于被他父亲带走了。
sentences.pinyin: Kěxī zhēngyuè guòqù le, Rùntǔ xū huí jiālǐ qù, wǒ jí de dàkū, tā yě duǒ dào chúfáng lǐ, kū zhe bùkěn chūmén, dàn zhōngyú bèi tā fùqīn dàizǒu le.
sentences.en: Sadly, the first month came to an end and Runtu had to go home. I was so upset I burst into tears, and he hid in the kitchen, crying and refusing to leave, but in the end his father took him away.

sentences.cn: 他后来还托他的父亲带给我一包贝壳和几支很好看的鸟毛，我也曾送他一两次东西，但从此没有再见面。
sentences.pinyin: Tā hòulái hái tuō tā de fùqīn dàigěi wǒ yìbāo bèiké hé jǐzhī hěn hǎokàn de niǎomáo, wǒ yě céng sòng tā yì liǎngcì dōngxi, dàn cóngcǐ méiyǒu zài jiànmiàn.
sentences.en: Later he had his father bring me a packet of shells and a few very pretty feathers, and I sent him things once or twice too, but we never saw each other again.

sentences.cn: 现在我的母亲提起了他，我这儿时的记忆，忽而全都闪电似的苏生过来，似乎看到了我的美丽的故乡了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ de mǔqīn tíqǐ le tā, wǒ zhè érshí de jìyì, hū'ér quándōu shǎndiàn shìde sūshēng guòlái, sìhū kàndào le wǒ de měilì de gùxiāng le.
sentences.en: Now that my mother had mentioned him, all these childhood memories suddenly came back to life like a flash of lightning, and I seemed to see my beautiful hometown at last.

sentences.cn: 我应声说：
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yìngshēng shuō:
sentences.en: I answered:

sentences.cn: “这好极！他，——怎样？……”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè hǎo jí! Tā, ——zěnyàng? ……”
sentences.en: "That's wonderful! And how — how is he?…"

sentences.cn: “他？……他景况也很不如意……”母亲说着，便向房外看，“这些人又来了。
sentences.pinyin: “Tā? …… Tā jǐngkuàng yě hěn bùrúyì……” mǔqīn shuō zhe, biàn xiàng fáng wài kàn, “zhèxiē rén yòu lái le.
sentences.en: "Him?… Things haven't gone well for him either…" Mother said, glancing outside. "Those people are here again.

sentences.cn: 说是买木器，顺手也就随便拿走的，我得去看看。”
sentences.pinyin: Shuō shì mǎi mùqì, shùnshǒu yějiù suíbiàn názǒu de, wǒ děi qù kànkàn.”
sentences.en: They say they've come to buy furniture, but they just help themselves to whatever they like. I'd better go and look."

sentences.cn: 母亲站起身，出去了。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn zhàn qǐshēn, chūqù le.
sentences.en: Mother stood up and went out.

sentences.cn: 门外有几个女人的声音。
sentences.pinyin: Ménwài yǒu jǐgè nǚrén de shēngyīn.
sentences.en: I could hear several women's voices outside the door.

sentences.cn: 我便招宏儿走近面前，和他闲话：问他可会写字，可愿意出门。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ biàn zhāo Hóng'ér zǒujìn miànqián, hé tā xiánhuà: wèn tā kě huì xiězì, kě yuànyì chūmén.
sentences.en: I beckoned Hong'er over and chatted with him: I asked him whether he could write, and whether he wanted to go away.

sentences.cn: “我们坐火车去么？”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒmen zuò huǒchē qù me?”
sentences.en: "Will we go by train?"

sentences.cn: “我们坐火车去。”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒmen zuò huǒchē qù.”
sentences.en: "We'll go by train."

sentences.cn: “船呢？”
sentences.pinyin: “Chuán ne?”
sentences.en: "What about by boat?"

sentences.pinyin: “Xiān zuòchuán, ……”
sentences.en: "First by boat…"

sentences.cn: “哈！这模样了！胡子这么长了！”一种尖利的怪声突然大叫起来。
sentences.pinyin: “Hā! Zhè múyàng le! Húzi zhème cháng le!” Yìzhǒng jiānlì de guàishēng tūrán dà jiào qǐlái.
sentences.en: "Ha! Look at you now! Such a long moustache!" a strange, shrill voice suddenly shrieked.

sentences.cn: 我吃了一吓，赶忙抬起头，却见一个凸颧骨，薄嘴唇，五十岁上下的女人站在我面前，两手搭在髀间，没有系裙，张着两脚，正像一个画图仪器里细脚伶仃的圆规。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ chī le yí xià, gǎnmáng táiqǐ tóu, què jiàn yígè tū quángǔ, báo zuǐchún, wǔshí suì shàngxià de nǚrén zhànzài wǒ miànqián, liǎngshǒu dāzài bìjiān, méiyǒu jì qún, zhāng zhe liǎng jiǎo, zhèngxiàng yígè huàtú yíqì lǐ xìjiǎolíngdīng de yuánguī.
sentences.en: Startled, I quickly looked up and saw a woman of about fifty standing in front of me, with high cheekbones and thin lips. Her hands were on her hips, she wore no skirt, and she stood with her legs apart, exactly like a pair of compasses from a drawing set, all thin spindly legs.

sentences.cn: 我愕然了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ èrán le.
sentences.en: I was taken aback.

sentences.cn: “不认识了么？我还抱过你咧！”
sentences.pinyin: “Bú rènshi le me? Wǒ hái bào guò nǐ lie!”
sentences.en: "Don't you recognise me? Why, I used to carry you in my arms!"

sentences.cn: 我愈加愕然了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yùjiā èrán le.
sentences.en: I was even more taken aback.

sentences.cn: 幸而我的母亲也就进来，从旁说：
sentences.pinyin: Xìng'ér wǒ de mǔqīn yějiù jìnlái, cóngpáng shuō:
sentences.en: Luckily my mother came in just then and said from the side:

sentences.cn: “他多年出门，统忘却了。你该记得罢，”便向着我说，“这是斜对门的杨二嫂，……开豆腐店的。”
sentences.pinyin: “Tā duōnián chūmén, tǒng wàngquè le. Nǐ gāi jìde ba,” biàn xiàng zhe wǒ shuō, “zhè shì xié duìmén de Yáng'èrsǎo, …… kāi dòufudiàn de.”
sentences.en: "He's been away so many years, he's forgotten everything." Then, turning to me: "Surely you remember — this is Second Sister-in-law Yang from across the street… the one with the beancurd shop."

sentences.cn: 哦，我记得了。
sentences.pinyin: Ò, wǒ jìde le.
sentences.en: Oh, now I remembered.

sentences.cn: 我孩子时候，在斜对门的豆腐店里确乎终日坐着一个杨二嫂，人都叫伊“豆腐西施”。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ háizi shíhou, zài xié duìmén de dòufudiàn lǐ quèhū zhōngrì zuò zhe yígè Yáng'èrsǎo, rén dōu jiào yī “dòufu Xīshī”.
sentences.en: When I was a child, there really had been a Second Sister-in-law Yang who sat all day in the beancurd shop across the street, and everyone called her the "Beancurd Beauty."

sentences.cn: 但是擦着白粉，颧骨没有这么高，嘴唇也没有这么薄，而且终日坐着，我也从没有见过这圆规式的姿势。
sentences.pinyin: Dànshì cā zhe báifěn, quángǔ méiyǒu zhème gāo, zuǐchún yě méiyǒu zhème báo, érqiě zhōngrì zuò zhe, wǒ yě cóng méiyǒu jiànguò zhè yuánguī shì de zīshì.
sentences.en: But she used to wear white powder, her cheekbones were not so high nor her lips so thin, and since she sat all day long, I had never seen her in this compass-like pose.

sentences.cn: 那时人说：因为伊，这豆腐店的买卖非常好。
sentences.pinyin: Nàshí rén shuō: yīnwèi yī, zhè dòufudiàn de mǎimài fēicháng hǎo.
sentences.en: People said back then that it was because of her that the beancurd shop did such good business.

sentences.cn: 但这大约因为年龄的关系，我却并未蒙着一毫感化，所以竟完全忘却了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn zhè dàyuē yīnwèi niánlíng de guānxì, wǒ què bìng wèi méng zhe yìháo gǎnhuà, suǒyǐ jìng wánquán wàngquè le.
sentences.en: But probably because of my age at the time, I was not the least bit affected by her charms, and so I had forgotten her completely.

sentences.cn: 然而圆规很不平，显出鄙夷的神色，仿佛嗤笑法国人不知道拿破仑，美国人不知道华盛顿似的，冷笑说：
sentences.pinyin: Rán'ér yuánguī hěn bùpíng, xiǎnchū bǐyí de shénsè, fǎngfú chīxiào Fǎguó rén bùzhīdào Nápòlún, Měiguó rén bùzhīdào Huáshèngdùn shìde, lěngxiào shuō:
sentences.en: The Compasses, however, was most indignant. With a look of contempt, as if mocking a Frenchman who had never heard of Napoleon or an American who had never heard of Washington, she sneered:

sentences.cn: “忘了？这真是贵人眼高……”
sentences.pinyin: “Wàng le? Zhè zhēnshì guìrén yǎngāo……”
sentences.en: "Forgotten? Well, important people do look down on others…"

sentences.cn: “那有这事……我……”我惶恐着，站起来说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nǎ yǒu zhè shì…… wǒ……” wǒ huángkǒng zhe, zhànqǐlái shuō.
sentences.en: "That's not it at all… I…" I said nervously, getting to my feet.

sentences.cn: “那么，我对你说。
sentences.pinyin: “Nàme, wǒ duì nǐ shuō.
sentences.en: "Then let me tell you something.

sentences.cn: 迅哥儿，你阔了，搬动又笨重，你还要什么这些破烂木器，让我拿去罢。
sentences.pinyin: Xùn gēr, nǐ kuò le, bāndòng yòu bènzhòng, nǐ hái yào shénme zhèxiē pòlàn mùqì, ràng wǒ náqù ba.
sentences.en: Brother Xun, you're rich now, and these things are heavy to move. What do you want with this battered old furniture? Let me take it.

sentences.cn: 我们小户人家，用得着。”
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎohù rénjiā, yòng dezháo.”
sentences.en: Poor folk like us can use it."

sentences.cn: “我并没有阔哩。我须卖了这些，再去……”
sentences.pinyin: “Wǒ bìng méiyǒu kuò li. Wǒ xū mài le zhèxiē, zàiqù……”
sentences.en: "I'm not rich at all. I have to sell these, and then…"

sentences.cn: “阿呀呀，你放了道台了，还说不阔？
sentences.pinyin: “Āyāyā, nǐ fàng le dàotái le, hái shuō bú kuò?
sentences.en: "Oh my, oh my! You've been made a Daotai, and you say you're not rich?

sentences.cn: 你现在有三房姨太太；出门便是八抬的大轿，还说不阔？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu sānfáng yítàitài; chūmén biànshì bātái de dàjiào, hái shuō bú kuò?
sentences.en: You've got three concubines now, and when you go out it's in a big sedan chair carried by eight men — and you say you're not rich?

sentences.cn: 吓，什么都瞒不过我。”
sentences.pinyin: Hè, shénme dōu mán búguò wǒ.”
sentences.en: Hah, you can't hide anything from me."

sentences.cn: 我知道无话可说了，便闭了口，默默的站着。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào wúhuàkěshuō le, biàn bì le kǒu, mòmò de zhàn zhe.
sentences.en: I knew there was nothing I could say, so I shut my mouth and stood there in silence.

sentences.cn: “阿呀阿呀，真是愈有钱，便愈是一毫不肯放松，愈是一毫不肯放松，便愈有钱……”
sentences.pinyin: “Āyā āyā, zhēnshì yù yǒu qián, biàn yù shì yìháo bùkěn fàngsōng, yù shì yìháo bùkěn fàngsōng, biàn yù yǒu qián……”
sentences.en: "Oh my, oh my — it's true: the richer people get, the less they'll part with a single cent, and the less they'll part with a single cent, the richer they get…"

sentences.cn: 圆规一面愤愤的回转身，一面絮絮的说，慢慢向外走，顺便将我母亲的一副手套塞在裤腰里，出去了。
sentences.pinyin: Yuánguī yímiàn fènfèn de huízhuǎn shēn, yímiàn xùxù de shuō, mànmàn xiàngwài zǒu, shùnbiàn jiāng wǒ mǔqīn de yífù shǒutào sāi zài kùyāo lǐ, chūqù le.
sentences.en: The Compasses turned away indignantly, still muttering on and on, and walked slowly out — slipping a pair of my mother's gloves into the waistband of her trousers on the way.

sentences.cn: 此后又有近处的本家和亲戚来访问我。
sentences.pinyin: Cǐhòu yòu yǒu jìnchù de běnjiā hé qīnqi lái fǎngwèn wǒ.
sentences.en: After that, relatives and clansmen from nearby came to call on me.

sentences.cn: 我一面应酬，偷空便收拾些行李，这样的过了三四天。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yímiàn yìngchou, tōukòng biàn shōushi xiē xíngli, zhèyàng de guò le sān sì tiān.
sentences.en: I entertained them, and in spare moments did some packing; three or four days passed this way.

sentences.cn: 一日是天气很冷的午后，我吃过午饭，坐着喝茶，觉得外面有人进来了，便回头去看。
sentences.pinyin: Yírì shì tiānqì hěn lěng de wǔhòu, wǒ chī guò wǔfàn, zuò zhe hēchá, juéde wàimiàn yǒurén jìnlái le, biàn huítóu qù kàn.
sentences.en: One very cold afternoon, after lunch, I was sitting drinking tea when I sensed someone coming in from outside, so I turned round to look.

sentences.cn: 我看时，不由的非常出惊，慌忙站起身，迎着走去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ kàn shí, bùyóu de fēicháng chūjīng, huāngmáng zhàn qǐshēn, yíng zhe zǒuqù.
sentences.en: When I saw who it was, I couldn't help being astonished; I hurried to my feet and went to meet him.

sentences.cn: 这来的便是闰土。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè lái de biànshì Rùntǔ.
sentences.en: The visitor was Runtu.

sentences.cn: 虽然我一见便知道是闰土，但又不是我这记忆上的闰土了。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yí jiàn biàn zhīdào shì Rùntǔ, dàn yòu búshì wǒ zhè jìyì shàng de Rùntǔ le.
sentences.en: Although I knew at a glance that it was Runtu, he was no longer the Runtu of my memory.

sentences.cn: 他身材增加了一倍；先前的紫色的圆脸，已经变作灰黄，而且加上了很深的皱纹；眼睛也像他父亲一样，周围都肿得通红，这我知道，在海边种地的人，终日吹着海风，大抵是这样的。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shēncái zēngjiā le yíbèi; xiānqián de zǐsè de yuán liǎn, yǐjīng biànzuò huī huáng, érqiě jiāshàng le hěn shēn de zhòuwén; yǎnjing yěxiàng tā fùqīn yíyàng, zhōuwéi dōu zhǒng de tōnghóng, zhè wǒ zhīdào, zài hǎibiān zhòngdì de rén, zhōngrì chuīzhe hǎifēng, dàdǐ shì zhèyàng de.
sentences.en: He was twice the size he had been. His round, ruddy face had turned a sallow grey and was lined with deep wrinkles; his eyes, like his father's, were swollen and red around the rims — I knew that people who farm by the sea, in the sea wind all day, mostly end up like that.

sentences.cn: 他头上是一顶破毡帽，身上只一件极薄的棉衣，浑身瑟索着；手里提着一个纸包和一支长烟管，那手也不是我所记得的红活圆实的手，却又粗又笨而且开裂，像是松树皮了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā tóu shàng shì yìdǐng pò zhānmào, shēnshàng zhǐ yíjiàn jí báo de miányī, húnshēn sèsuǒ zhe; shǒulǐ tí zhe yígè zhǐbāo hé yìzhī cháng yānguǎn, nà shǒu yě búshì wǒ suǒ jìde de hónghuóyuánshí de shǒu, què yòu cū yòu bèn érqiě kāiliè, xiàngshì sōngshù pí le.
sentences.en: On his head was a shabby felt cap, and he wore only one very thin padded jacket, so he was shivering all over. He carried a paper package and a long pipe, and his hands were not the plump, rosy, lively hands I remembered, but coarse, clumsy and cracked, like the bark of a pine tree.

sentences.cn: 我这时很兴奋，但不知道怎么说才好，只是说：
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhèshí hěn xīngfèn, dàn bùzhīdào zěnmeshuō cáihǎo, zhǐshì shuō:
sentences.en: I was very excited, but didn't know what to say, and could only say:

sentences.cn: “阿！闰土哥，——你来了？……”
sentences.pinyin: “Ā! Rùntǔ gē, ——nǐ lái le? ……”
sentences.en: "Ah! Brother Runtu — you've come?…"

sentences.cn: 我接着便有许多话，想要连珠一般涌出：角鸡，跳鱼儿，贝壳，猹，……
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiēzhe biàn yǒu xǔduō huà, xiǎngyào liánzhū yìbān yǒngchū: jiǎojī, tiàoyúr, bèiké, chá, ……
sentences.en: Then I had so much to say, wanting it all to pour out like a string of pearls: horned pheasants, jumping fish, shells, zha…

sentences.cn: 但又总觉得被什么挡着似的，单在脑里面回旋，吐不出口外去。
sentences.pinyin: Dàn yòu zǒng juéde bèi shénme dǎngzhe shìde, dān zài nǎo lǐmiàn huíxuán, tǔ bù chū kǒu wài qù.
sentences.en: But somehow it felt as if something was blocking it; the words just went round and round in my head and would not come out of my mouth.

sentences.cn: 他站住了，脸上现出欢喜和凄凉的神情；动着嘴唇，却没有作声。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhànzhù le, liǎn shàng xiàn chū huānxǐ hé qīliáng de shénqíng; dòng zhe zuǐchún, què méiyǒu zuòshēng.
sentences.en: He stood still, his face showing both joy and sadness. His lips moved, but he made no sound.

sentences.cn: 他的态度终于恭敬起来了，分明的叫道：
sentences.pinyin: Tā de tàidù zhōngyú gōngjìng qǐlái le, fēnmíng de jiào dào:
sentences.en: Finally his manner became respectful, and he said clearly:

sentences.pinyin: “Lǎoye! ……”
sentences.en: "Master!…"

sentences.cn: 我似乎打了一个寒噤；我就知道，我们之间已经隔了一层可悲的厚障壁了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ sìhū dǎ le yígè hánjìn; wǒ jiù zhīdào, wǒmen zhījiān yǐjīng gé le yìcéng kěbēi de hòu zhàngbì le.
sentences.en: I felt as if I had shivered; I knew then that a sad, thick wall had grown up between us.

sentences.cn: 我也说不出话。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě shuōbùchū huà.
sentences.en: I could not speak either.

sentences.cn: 他回过头去说，“水生，给老爷磕头。”
sentences.pinyin: Tā huíguòtóu qù shuō, “Shuǐshēng, gěi lǎoye kētóu.”
sentences.en: He turned his head and said, "Shuisheng, kowtow to the master."

sentences.cn: 便拖出躲在背后的孩子来，这正是一个廿年前的闰土，只是黄瘦些，颈子上没有银圈罢了。
sentences.pinyin: Biàn tuōchū duǒzài bèihòu de háizi lái, zhè zhèngshì yígè niàn niánqián de Rùntǔ, zhǐshì huángshòu xiē, jǐngzi shàng méiyǒu yínquān bàle.
sentences.en: Then he pulled out a child who had been hiding behind him — the very image of Runtu twenty years before, only paler and thinner, and with no silver ring around his neck.

sentences.cn: “这是第五个孩子，没有见过世面，躲躲闪闪……”
sentences.pinyin: “Zhè shì dìwǔ gè háizi, méiyǒu jiànguò shìmiàn, duǒduǒshǎnshǎn……”
sentences.en: "This is my fifth child. He hasn't seen anything of the world, so he's shy…"

sentences.cn: 母亲和宏儿下楼来了，他们大约也听到了声音。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn hé Hóng'ér xiàlóu lái le, tāmen dàyuē yě tīngdào le shēngyīn.
sentences.en: Mother and Hong'er came downstairs; they had probably heard our voices.

sentences.cn: “老太太。信是早收到了。我实在喜欢的不得了，知道老爷回来……”闰土说。
sentences.pinyin: “Lǎotàitài. Xìn shì zǎo shōudào le. Wǒ shízài xǐhuan de bùdéliǎo, zhīdào lǎoye huílái……” Rùntǔ shuō.
sentences.en: "Madam. I got your letter some time ago. I was really so happy to know the master was coming back…" said Runtu.

sentences.cn: “阿，你怎的这样客气起来。
sentences.pinyin: “Ā, nǐ zěnde zhèyàng kèqi qǐlái.
sentences.en: "Oh, why are you being so formal?

sentences.cn: 你们先前不是哥弟称呼么？
sentences.pinyin: Nǐmen xiānqián búshì gēdì chēnghu me?
sentences.en: Didn't you two use to call each other brother?

sentences.cn: 还是照旧：迅哥儿。”母亲高兴的说。
sentences.pinyin: Háishì zhàojiù: Xùn gēr.” Mǔqīn gāoxìng de shuō.
sentences.en: Call him what you used to: Brother Xun," Mother said cheerfully.

sentences.cn: “阿呀，老太太真是……这成什么规矩。那时是孩子，不懂事……”
sentences.pinyin: “Āyā, lǎotàitài zhēnshì…… zhè chéng shénme guīju. Nàshí shì háizi, bùdǒng shì……”
sentences.en: "Oh, Madam, really… that wouldn't be proper at all. We were children then and didn't know any better…"

sentences.cn: 闰土说着，又叫水生上来打拱，那孩子却害羞，紧紧的只贴在他背后。
sentences.pinyin: Rùntǔ shuō zhe, yòu jiào Shuǐshēng shànglái dǎgǒng, nà háizi què hàixiū, jǐnjǐn de zhǐ tiē zài tā bèihòu.
sentences.en: As he said this, Runtu told Shuisheng to come forward and bow, but the child was shy and clung tightly to his father's back.

sentences.cn: “他就是水生？第五个？
sentences.pinyin: “Tā jiùshì Shuǐshēng? Dìwǔ gè?
sentences.en: "So he's Shuisheng? Your fifth?

sentences.cn: 都是生人，怕生也难怪的；还是宏儿和他去走走。”母亲说。
sentences.pinyin: Dōushì shēngrén, pàshēng yě nánguài de; háishì Hóng'ér hé tā qù zǒuzǒu.” Mǔqīn shuō.
sentences.en: We're all strangers to him, so it's no wonder he's shy. Hong'er, why don't you take him out for a walk," said Mother.

sentences.cn: 宏儿听得这话，便来招水生，水生却松松爽爽同他一路出去了。
sentences.pinyin: Hóng'ér tīng de zhè huà, biàn lái zhāo Shuǐshēng, Shuǐshēng què sōngsōngshuǎngshuǎng tóng tā yílù chūqù le.
sentences.en: Hearing this, Hong'er came and beckoned to Shuisheng, and Shuisheng went off with him quite happily.

sentences.cn: 母亲叫闰土坐，他迟疑了一回，终于就了坐，将长烟管靠在桌旁，递过纸包来，说：
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn jiào Rùntǔ zuò, tā chíyí le yìhuí, zhōngyú jiù le zuò, jiāng cháng yānguǎn kàozài zhuō páng, dì guò zhǐbāo lái, shuō:
sentences.en: Mother asked Runtu to sit down. He hesitated for a while, but finally took a seat, leaned his long pipe against the table and handed over the paper package, saying:

sentences.cn: “冬天没有什么东西了。
sentences.pinyin: “Dōngtiān méiyǒu shénme dōngxi le.
sentences.en: "There's not much to be had in winter.

sentences.cn: 这一点干青豆倒是自家晒在那里的，请老爷……”
sentences.pinyin: Zhè yìdiǎn gān qīngdòu dàoshì zì jiā shài zài nàlǐ de, qǐng lǎoye……”
sentences.en: But these few dried green beans we dried ourselves. Please, master…"

sentences.cn: 我问问他的景况。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ wèn wen tā de jǐngkuàng.
sentences.en: I asked him how things were with him.

sentences.cn: 他只是摇头。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì yáotóu.
sentences.en: He just shook his head.

sentences.cn: “非常难。第六个孩子也会帮忙了，却总是吃不够……
sentences.pinyin: “Fēicháng nán. Dìliù gè háizi yě huì bāngmáng le, què zǒngshì chī bugòu……
sentences.en: "Very hard. My sixth child can help out now, but we never have enough to eat…

sentences.cn: 又不太平……
sentences.pinyin: Yòu bú tàipíng……
sentences.en: And there's no peace…

sentences.cn: 什么地方都要钱，没有规定……
sentences.pinyin: Shénme dìfāng dōuyào qián, méiyǒu guīdìng……
sentences.en: Everywhere wants money, there are no fixed rules…

sentences.cn: 收成又坏。
sentences.pinyin: Shōuchéng yòu huài.
sentences.en: And the harvests are bad.

sentences.cn: 种出东西来，挑去卖，总要捐几回钱，折了本；不去卖，又只能烂掉……”
sentences.pinyin: Zhòng chū dōngxi lái, tiāo qù mài, zǒng yào juān jǐ huí qián, shé le běn; búqù mài, yòu zhǐnéng làndiào……”
sentences.en: When we grow something and carry it to market, we always have to pay taxes several times over and lose money; if we don't sell it, it just rots…"

sentences.cn: 他只是摇头；脸上虽然刻着许多皱纹，却全然不动，仿佛石像一般。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì yáotóu; liǎn shàng suīrán kè zhe xǔduō zhòuwén, què quánrán búdòng, fǎngfú shíxiàng yìbān.
sentences.en: He kept shaking his head. Though his face was carved with deep lines, it did not move at all, as if it were a stone statue.

sentences.cn: 他大约只是觉得苦，却又形容不出，沉默了片时，便拿起烟管来默默的吸烟了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dàyuē zhǐshì juéde kǔ, què yòu xíngróng bùchū, chénmò le piànshí, biàn náqǐ yānguǎn lái mòmò de xīyān le.
sentences.en: He probably just felt the bitterness without being able to put it into words. After a moment's silence he picked up his pipe and smoked without a word.

sentences.cn: 母亲问他，知道他的家里事务忙，明天便得回去；又没有吃过午饭，便叫他自己到厨下炒饭吃去。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn wèn tā, zhīdào tā de jiālǐ shìwù máng, míngtiān biàn děi huíqù; yòu méiyǒu chī guò wǔfàn, biàn jiào tā zìjǐ dào chúxià chǎofàn chī qù.
sentences.en: Mother asked him and learned that he was busy at home and had to go back the next day. He hadn't had lunch yet, so she told him to go to the kitchen and fry himself some rice.

sentences.cn: 他出去了；母亲和我都叹息他的景况：多子，饥荒，苛税，兵，匪，官，绅，都苦得他像一个木偶人了。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chūqù le; mǔqīn hé wǒ dōu tànxī tā de jǐngkuàng: duōzǐ, jīhuāng, kēshuì, bīng, fěi, guān, shēn, dōu kǔ de tā xiàng yígè mù'ǒu rén le.
sentences.en: After he went out, Mother and I both sighed over his situation: too many children, famine, harsh taxes, soldiers, bandits, officials, gentry — all of them had worn him down until he was like a wooden puppet.

sentences.cn: 母亲对我说，凡是不必搬走的东西，尽可以送他，可以听他自己去拣择。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn duì wǒ shuō, fánshì búbì bānzǒu de dōngxi, jǐn kěyǐ sòng tā, kěyǐ tīng tā zìjǐ qù jiǎnzé.
sentences.en: Mother told me that anything we didn't need to take with us, we could give to him, and let him choose for himself.

sentences.cn: 下午，他拣好了几件东西：两条长桌，四个椅子，一副香炉和烛台，一杆抬秤。
sentences.pinyin: Xiàwǔ, tā jiǎn hǎo le jǐ jiàn dōngxi: liǎng tiáo chángzhuō, sì gè yǐzi, yífù xiānglú hé zhútái, yìgǎn táichèng.
sentences.en: In the afternoon he picked out a few things: two long tables, four chairs, an incense burner and candlesticks, and a large steelyard scale.

sentences.cn: 他又要所有的草灰（我们这里煮饭是烧稻草的，那灰，可以做沙地的肥料），待我们启程的时候，他用船来载去。
sentences.pinyin: Tā yòu yào suǒyǒu de cǎohuī (wǒmen zhèlǐ zhǔ fàn shì shāo dàocǎo de, nà huī, kěyǐ zuò shādì de féiliào), dài wǒmen qǐchéng de shíhou, tā yòng chuán lái zài qù.
sentences.en: He also asked for all the straw ash (here we burn rice straw to cook, and the ash can be used to fertilise the sandy soil); when we set off, he would come with a boat to carry it away.

sentences.cn: 夜间，我们又谈些闲天，都是无关紧要的话；第二天早晨，他就领了水生回去了。
sentences.pinyin: Yèjiān, wǒmen yòu tán xiē xiántiān, dōushì wúguānjǐnyào de huà; dì'èr tiān zǎochén, tā jiù lǐng le Shuǐshēng huíqù le.
sentences.en: In the evening we chatted a little more, about nothing of any importance. The next morning he took Shuisheng and went home.

partTitle.cn: 第五部分：走的人多了，也便成了路
partTitle.en: Part 5: When Many People Walk, a Road Appears

sentences.cn: 又过了九日，是我们启程的日期。
sentences.pinyin: Yòu guò le jiǔrì, shì wǒmen qǐchéng de rìqī.
sentences.en: Nine days later came the day of our departure.

sentences.cn: 闰土早晨便到了，水生没有同来，却只带着一个五岁的女儿管船只。
sentences.pinyin: Rùntǔ zǎochén biàn dào le, Shuǐshēng méiyǒu tóng lái, què zhǐ dài zhe yígè wǔsuì de nǚ'ér guǎn chuánzhī.
sentences.en: Runtu arrived in the morning. Shuisheng had not come with him; instead he had brought only his five-year-old daughter to look after the boat.

sentences.cn: 我们终日很忙碌，再没有谈天的工夫。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngrì hěn mánglù, zài méiyǒu tántiān de gōngfu.
sentences.en: We were busy all day long and had no more time to talk.

sentences.cn: 来客也不少，有送行的，有拿东西的，有送行兼拿东西的。
sentences.pinyin: Láikè yě bùshǎo, yǒu sòngxíng de, yǒu ná dōngxi de, yǒu sòngxíng jiān ná dōngxi de.
sentences.en: There were plenty of visitors too: some came to see us off, some came to take things, and some came both to see us off and to take things.

sentences.cn: 待到傍晚我们上船的时候，这老屋里的所有破旧大小粗细东西，已经一扫而空了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàidào bàngwǎn wǒmen shàngchuán de shíhou, zhè lǎowū lǐ de suǒyǒu pòjiù dàxiǎo cūxì dōngxi, yǐjīng yìsǎo'érkōng le.
sentences.en: By the time we boarded the boat in the evening, every old and worn-out thing in the house, big or small, rough or fine, had been swept clean away.

sentences.cn: 我们的船向前走，两岸的青山在黄昏中，都装成了深黛颜色，连着退向船后梢去。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de chuán xiàngqián zǒu, liǎng'àn de qīngshān zài huánghūn zhōng, dōu zhuāng chéng le shēndài yánsè, lián zhe tuì xiàng chuán hòushāo qù.
sentences.en: Our boat moved forward. The green hills on both banks had turned a deep blue-black in the dusk, and one after another they slipped away behind the stern.

sentences.cn: 宏儿和我靠着船窗，同看外面模糊的风景，他忽然问道：
sentences.pinyin: Hóng'ér hé wǒ kào zhe chuán chuāng, tóng kàn wàimiàn móhu de fēngjǐng, tā hūrán wèndào:
sentences.en: Hong'er and I leaned against the cabin window, looking out together at the blurred scenery, when he suddenly asked:

sentences.cn: “大伯！我们什么时候回来？”
sentences.pinyin: “Dàbó! Wǒmen shénme shíhou huílái?”
sentences.en: "Uncle! When are we coming back?"

sentences.cn: “回来？你怎么还没有走就想回来了。”
sentences.pinyin: “Huílái? Nǐ zěnme hái méiyǒu zǒu jiù xiǎng huílái le.”
sentences.en: "Coming back? Why are you thinking of coming back before we've even left?"

sentences.cn: “可是，水生约我到他家玩去咧……”他睁着大的黑眼睛，痴痴的想。
sentences.pinyin: “Kěshì, Shuǐshēng yuē wǒ dào tā jiā wán qù lie……” tā zhēng zhe dà de hēi yǎnjing, chīchī de xiǎng.
sentences.en: "But Shuisheng invited me to come and play at his house…" His big dark eyes were wide open as he sat lost in thought.

sentences.cn: 我和母亲也都有些惘然，于是又提起闰土来。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ hé mǔqīn yě dōu yǒu xiē wǎngrán, yúshì yòu tíqǐ Rùntǔ lái.
sentences.en: Mother and I both felt a little lost too, and so we started talking about Runtu again.

sentences.cn: 母亲说，那豆腐西施的杨二嫂，自从我家收拾行李以来，本是每日必到的，前天伊在灰堆里，掏出十多个碗碟来，议论之后，便定说是闰土埋着的，他可以在运灰的时候，一齐搬回家里去；
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn shuō, nà dòufu Xīshī de Yáng'èrsǎo, zìcóng wǒ jiā shōushi xíngli yǐlái, běn shì měirì bì dào de, qián tiān yī zài huīduī lǐ, tāochū shíduōgè wǎndié lái, yìlùn zhīhòu, biàn dìng shuō shì Rùntǔ mái zhe de, tā kěyǐ zài yùn huī de shíhou, yìqí bānhuí jiālǐ qù;
sentences.en: Mother said that ever since we had started packing, Second Sister-in-law Yang, the Beancurd Beauty, had come round every single day. The day before yesterday she had dug a dozen or so bowls and plates out of the ash heap, and after some discussion she declared that Runtu had buried them there, so that he could carry them all home along with the ash.

sentences.cn: 杨二嫂发见了这件事，自己很以为功，便拿了那狗气杀（这是我们这里养鸡的器具，木盘上面有着栅栏，内盛食料，鸡可以伸进颈子去啄，狗却不能，只能看着气死），飞也似的跑了，亏伊装着这么高低的小脚，竟跑得这样快。
sentences.pinyin: Yáng'èrsǎo fāxiàn le zhè jiàn shì, zìjǐ hěn yǐwéi gōng, biàn ná le nà gǒuqìshā (zhè shì wǒmen zhèlǐ yǎng jī de qìjù, mù pán shàngmiàn yǒuzhe zhàlan, nèi chéng shíliào, jī kěyǐ shēnjìn jǐngzi qù zhuó, gǒu què bùnéng, zhǐnéng kàn zhe qìsǐ), fēiyěshìde pǎo le, kuī yī zhuāngzhe zhème gāodī de xiǎojiǎo, jìng pǎo de zhèyàng kuài.
sentences.en: Very pleased with herself for this discovery, she then took the "dog-vexer" (a device we use here for feeding chickens: a wooden tray with a fence on top and feed inside, so that chickens can stretch their necks in to peck but dogs can't, and can only watch and fume) and ran off as if flying — amazing how fast she could run on those tiny bound feet in their high-soled shoes.

sentences.cn: 老屋离我愈远了；故乡的山水也都渐渐远离了我，但我却并不感到怎样的留恋。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎowū lí wǒ yù yuǎn le; gùxiāng de shānshuǐ yě dōu jiànjiàn yuǎnlí le wǒ, dàn wǒ què bìngbù gǎndào zěnyàng de liúliàn.
sentences.en: The old house fell further and further behind me; the hills and rivers of my hometown were slowly leaving me too, yet I felt no great reluctance to go.

sentences.cn: 我只觉得我四面有看不见的高墙，将我隔成孤身，使我非常气闷；那西瓜地上的银项圈的小英雄的影像，我本来十分清楚，现在却忽地模糊了，又使我非常的悲哀。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ juéde wǒ sìmiàn yǒu kànbújiàn de gāo qiáng, jiāng wǒ géchéng gūshēn, shǐ wǒ fēicháng qìmèn; nà xīguā dìshàng de yínxiàngquān de xiǎo yīngxióng de yǐngxiàng, wǒ běnlái shífēn qīngchu, xiànzài què hūdì móhu le, yòu shǐ wǒ fēicháng de bēi'āi.
sentences.en: I only felt that there were invisible high walls all around me, cutting me off and leaving me alone, which made me feel stifled. The image of that little hero with the silver necklace in the watermelon field, once so clear to me, had suddenly blurred, and this too made me very sad.

sentences.cn: 母亲和宏儿都睡着了。
sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn hé Hóng'ér dōu shuìzháo le.
sentences.en: Mother and Hong'er had both fallen asleep.

sentences.cn: 我躺着，听船底潺潺的水声，知道我在走我的路。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tǎng zhe, tīng chuándǐ chánchán de shuǐshēng, zhīdào wǒ zài zǒu wǒ de lù.
sentences.en: I lay listening to the water gurgling under the boat, and knew that I was going my own way.

sentences.cn: 我想：我竟与闰土隔绝到这地步了，但我们的后辈还是一气，宏儿不是正在想念水生么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng: wǒ jìng yǔ Rùntǔ géjué dào zhè dìbù le, dàn wǒmen de hòubèi háishì yíqì, Hóng'ér búshì zhèngzài xiǎngniàn Shuǐshēng me.
sentences.en: I thought: Runtu and I have become so cut off from each other, yet our children are still of one heart — isn't Hong'er missing Shuisheng right now?

sentences.cn: 我希望他们不再像我，又大家隔膜起来……
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng tāmen búzài xiàng wǒ, yòu dàjiā gémó qǐlái……
sentences.en: I hope they will not be like us, growing apart from each other…

sentences.cn: 然而我又不愿意他们因为要一气，都如我的辛苦展转而生活，也不愿意他们都如闰土的辛苦麻木而生活，也不愿意都如别人的辛苦恣睢而生活。
sentences.pinyin: Rán'ér wǒ yòu bú yuànyì tāmen yīnwèi yào yíqì, dōu rú wǒ de xīnkǔ zhǎnzhuǎn ér shēnghuó, yěbú yuànyì tāmen dōu rú Rùntǔ de xīnkǔ mámù ér shēnghuó, yěbú yuànyì dōu rú biérén de xīnkǔ zìsuī ér shēnghuó.
sentences.en: And yet I would not want them, for the sake of staying close, to live a hard, restless life like mine; nor a hard, numbed life like Runtu's; nor a hard, reckless life like other people's.

sentences.cn: 他们应该有新的生活，为我们所未经生活过的。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīnggāi yǒu xīnde shēnghuó, wèi wǒmen suǒ wèijīng shēnghuó guò de.
sentences.en: They should have a new life, a life we have never lived.

sentences.cn: 我想到希望，忽然害怕起来了。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dào xīwàng, hūrán hàipà qǐlái le.
sentences.en: When I thought of hope, I suddenly felt afraid.

sentences.cn: 闰土要香炉和烛台的时候，我还暗地里笑他，以为他总是崇拜偶像，什么时候都不忘却。
sentences.pinyin: Rùntǔ yào xiānglú hé zhútái de shíhou, wǒ hái àndìlǐ xiào tā, yǐwéi tā zǒngshì chóngbài ǒuxiàng, shénme shíhou dōu bú wàngquè.
sentences.en: When Runtu asked for the incense burner and candlesticks, I had secretly laughed at him, thinking he still worshipped idols and could never forget them.

sentences.cn: 现在我所谓希望，不也是我自己手制的偶像么？
sentences.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ suǒwèi xīwàng, bù yěshì wǒ zìjǐ shǒuzhì de ǒuxiàng me?
sentences.en: But wasn't what I called hope also an idol made with my own hands?

sentences.cn: 只是他的愿望切近，我的愿望茫远罢了。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐshì tā de yuànwàng qièjìn, wǒ de yuànwàng mángyuǎn bàle.
sentences.en: The only difference was that his wishes were close at hand, while mine were vague and far away.

sentences.cn: 我在朦胧中，眼前展开一片海边碧绿的沙地来，上面深蓝的天空中挂着一轮金黄的圆月。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài ménglóng zhōng, yǎnqián zhǎnkāi yípiàn hǎibiān bìlǜ de shādì lái, shàngmiàn shēnlán de tiānkōng zhōng guà zhe yìlún jīnhuáng de yuányuè.
sentences.en: As I drifted off, a stretch of jade-green sandy land by the sea spread out before my eyes, and above it a round golden moon hung in the deep blue sky.

sentences.cn: 我想：希望本是无所谓有，无所谓无的。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng: xīwàng běn shì wúsuǒwèi yǒu, wúsuǒwèi wú de.
sentences.en: I thought: hope cannot be said to exist, nor can it be said not to exist.

sentences.cn: 这正如地上的路；其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhèng rú dìshàng de lù; qíshí dìshàng běn méiyǒu lù, zǒu de rén duō le, yě biàn chéng le lù.
sentences.en: It is just like the roads across the earth. In fact, there were no roads on the earth to begin with; when many people walk the same way, a road comes into being.

exampleSentence.cn: 孩子们天天盼望着放暑假。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Háizimen tiāntiān pànwàng zhe fàng shǔjià.
exampleSentence.en: The children look forward to the summer holidays every day.

exampleSentence.cn: 时间久了，很多童年的记忆都变得模糊了。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Shíjiān jiǔ le, hěn duō tóngnián de jìyì dōu biàn de móhu le.
exampleSentence.en: After so long, many childhood memories have become blurred.

exampleSentence.cn: 听到这个消息，他沉默了很久。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, tā chénmò le hěn jiǔ.
exampleSentence.en: When he heard the news, he was silent for a long time.

exampleSentence.cn: 那种心情，我真不知道该怎么形容。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Nà zhǒng xīnqíng, wǒ zhēn bù zhīdào gāi zěnme xíngróng.
exampleSentence.en: I really don't know how to describe that feeling.

exampleSentence.cn: 她第一次上台表演，有点儿害羞。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Tā dì-yī cì shàngtái biǎoyǎn, yǒudiǎnr hàixiū.
exampleSentence.en: It was her first time performing on stage, so she was a little shy.

exampleSentence.cn: 明天一早就要出发，今晚得把行李收拾好。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Míngtiān yìzǎo jiù yào chūfā, jīnwǎn děi bǎ xíngli shōushi hǎo.
exampleSentence.en: We're leaving first thing tomorrow, so the luggage has to be packed tonight.

exampleSentence.cn: 冬天的海边空无一人，显得十分凄凉。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Dōngtiān de hǎibiān kōng wú yì rén, xiǎnde shífēn qīliáng.
exampleSentence.en: The seaside in winter is empty and looks very desolate.

exampleSentence.cn: 学生们恭敬地向老师鞠了一躬。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Xuéshengmen gōngjìng de xiàng lǎoshī jū le yì gōng.
exampleSentence.en: The students bowed respectfully to their teacher.

exampleSentence.cn: 毕业那天，大家都很留恋校园的生活。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Bìyè nà tiān, dàjiā dōu hěn liúliàn xiàoyuán de shēnghuó.
exampleSentence.en: On graduation day, everyone felt reluctant to leave campus life behind.

exampleSentence.cn: 长期的辛苦工作让他对生活变得麻木了。
exampleSentence.pinyin: Chángqī de xīnkǔ gōngzuò ràng tā duì shēnghuó biàn de mámù le.
exampleSentence.en: Years of hard work had left him numb to life.

grammarNotes.pattern: 早期白话：罢＝吧，么＝吗，伊＝她，的＝地
grammarNotes.explanation: Lu Xun wrote in the early vernacular of the 1920s, before today's standard forms settled. 罢 is the modern particle 吧, 么 at the end of a question is 吗, 伊 means 她 (she), and 的 is often used where modern Chinese writes adverbial 地 (远远的站着 = 远远地站着).
additionalExamples: 人都叫伊“豆腐西施”。（＝叫她）
additionalExamplesEn: Everyone called her the "Beancurd Beauty." (= 叫她)

grammarNotes.explanation: "It's only…, that's all." 罢了 at the end of a sentence plays something down, often with 只是, 不过 or 只 earlier in the sentence. Modern Chinese still uses it, especially in writing.
grammarNotes.exampleFromStory: 这只是我自己心情的改变罢了。
grammarNotes.exampleFromStoryEn: It was only my own mood that had changed, that's all.
additionalExamples: 我只是随便问问罢了，你别多想。
他不过是开个玩笑罢了。
additionalExamplesEn: I was just asking, that's all — don't read anything into it.
He was only joking, that's all.

grammarNotes.explanation: "The more…, the more…" 愈 is a written word for 越. Yang Ersao uses it twice in a row to make a sarcastic circular argument.
grammarNotes.exampleFromStory: 真是愈有钱，便愈是一毫不肯放松，愈是一毫不肯放松，便愈有钱……
grammarNotes.exampleFromStoryEn: It's true: the richer people get, the less they'll part with a single cent, and the less they'll part with a single cent, the richer they get…
additionalExamples: 雨愈下愈大，我们只好在车站等着。
additionalExamplesEn: The rain got heavier and heavier, so we had to wait at the station.
The more I read this book, the more I like it.

grammarNotes.explanation: Two actions happening at the same time: "while…, (also)…". It works like 一边……一边…… but sounds more written.
grammarNotes.exampleFromStory: 圆规一面愤愤的回转身，一面絮絮的说，慢慢向外走。
grammarNotes.exampleFromStoryEn: The Compasses turned away indignantly, muttering on and on, and walked slowly out.
additionalExamples: 他一面听，一面在本子上记着。
我们一面吃饭，一面聊着小时候的事。
additionalExamplesEn: He listened while taking notes in his notebook.
We ate and chatted about when we were little.

grammarNotes.explanation: "As if… / just like…". 似的 closes a comparison that starts with 仿佛, 像 or 好像. It can also follow a noun directly: 闪电似的 "like lightning".
grammarNotes.exampleFromStory: 但又总觉得被什么挡着似的，单在脑里面回旋，吐不出口外去。
grammarNotes.exampleFromStoryEn: But somehow it felt as if something was blocking it; the words just went round and round in my head and would not come out.
additionalExamples: 他高兴得像个孩子似的。
她仿佛什么都没听见似的，继续往前走。
additionalExamplesEn: He was as happy as a child.
She kept walking as if she hadn't heard anything.

grammarNotes.explanation: In the story's final lines 无所谓有，无所谓无 means "it cannot be said to exist, nor can it be said not to exist". In everyday modern Chinese, 无所谓 usually means "it doesn't matter / I don't mind".
grammarNotes.exampleFromStory: 希望本是无所谓有，无所谓无的。
grammarNotes.exampleFromStoryEn: Hope cannot be said to exist, nor can it be said not to exist.
additionalExamples: 去哪儿吃饭我都无所谓，你决定吧。
成功和失败，对他来说似乎无所谓。
additionalExamplesEn: I don't mind where we eat — you decide.
Success or failure seems to make no difference to him.

quiz.question: “我”这次回故乡是为了什么？
quiz.questionEn: Why does the narrator return to his hometown this time?
options: 回去过春节，看望老朋友
卖掉老屋，带着家人搬到外地去
在故乡买房子，准备以后住下来
去参加一次大祭祀
optionsEn: To spend the Spring Festival there and visit old friends
To sell the old house and move his family elsewhere
To buy a house in his hometown and settle down there
To take part in a great ancestral ceremony
quiz.explanation: 文章开头说：老屋已经卖给别姓了，必须在正月初一以前搬家到“我”谋食的异地去。
quiz.explanationEn: Early on we learn the old house has been sold and the family must move, before New Year's Day, to the place where the narrator earns his living.

quiz.question: 在“我”的记忆里，少年闰土是什么样的？
quiz.questionEn: In the narrator's memory, what was the boy Runtu like?
options: 胆小，什么都不懂
家里很有钱，常常进城
紫色的圆脸，戴着银项圈，知道很多海边的新鲜事
很爱读书，会写很多字
optionsEn: Timid, and knew nothing
From a rich family, often went to town
A round ruddy face and a silver neck-ring, and full of wonderful stories about the seaside
Loved reading and could write many characters
quiz.explanation: 少年闰土“紫色的圆脸……颈上套一个明晃晃的银项圈”，会捕鸟、捡贝壳、刺猹，“心里有无穷无尽的希奇的事”。
quiz.explanationEn: Young Runtu had "a round, ruddy-purple face… a gleaming silver ring around his neck", knew how to trap birds, collect shells and fight the zha, and his mind was "full of endless marvels."

quiz.question: 杨二嫂为什么被“我”叫做“圆规”？
quiz.questionEn: Why does the narrator call Yang Ersao "the Compasses"?
options: 因为她很会画画
因为她站着的时候两手搭在髀间、张着两脚，样子像圆规
因为她做事很有规矩
因为她卖的豆腐是圆的
optionsEn: Because she was good at drawing
Because she stood with her hands on her hips and her thin legs apart, like a pair of compasses
Because she was very proper in everything she did
Because the beancurd she sold was round
quiz.explanation: 她“两手搭在髀间，没有系裙，张着两脚，正像一个画图仪器里细脚伶仃的圆规”。
quiz.explanationEn: She stood "with her hands on her hips… her legs apart, exactly like a pair of compasses from a drawing set, all thin spindly legs."

quiz.question: 闰土见到“我”时叫了一声“老爷”。这说明了什么？
quiz.questionEn: When Runtu sees the narrator, he calls him "Master". What does this show?
options: 闰土忘记了“我”的名字
闰土在开玩笑
两个人之间已经隔了一层“可悲的厚障壁”，不再是平等的朋友了
“我”真的做了大官
optionsEn: Runtu had forgotten the narrator's name
Runtu was joking
A "sad, thick wall" had grown up between them; they were no longer equals and friends
The narrator really had become a high official
quiz.explanation: “我就知道，我们之间已经隔了一层可悲的厚障壁了。”生活的苦和社会地位的不同，让童年的朋友变得陌生。
quiz.explanationEn: "I knew then that a sad, thick wall had grown up between us." Hardship and the gap in social status had turned childhood friends into strangers.

quiz.question: 小说最后一句“其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路”表达了什么意思？
quiz.questionEn: What does the final line, "there were no roads on the earth to begin with; when many people walk the same way, a road comes into being," express?
options: 故乡的路太少，应该多修路
希望本身说不上有没有，只要很多人去追求、去走，就能变成现实
走路比坐船更好
人们应该留在故乡，不要出门
optionsEn: The hometown had too few roads and more should be built
Hope cannot simply be said to exist or not; if enough people pursue it and walk that way, it can become real
Walking is better than travelling by boat
People should stay in their hometown and not go away
quiz.explanation: 作者把希望比作地上的路：希望“无所谓有，无所谓无”，要靠许多人一起去走，才会成为现实。
quiz.explanationEn: The author compares hope to a road: it "cannot be said to exist, nor not to exist"; it becomes real only when many people walk towards it together.
